Title: Comment
Content: Objective Share your feedback with the team with CLO-SET Comment feature. Creating Comment Attach Images in Comment Search Comment Workroom &amp Assortment Comment Web Tech Pack Comment Permission Notification Details 1) Creating Comment 1. Create Comment: click icon from top-right corner, and start creating comments. You can tag individual user or Teams by using @ (ex. @clovirtualfashion). Maximum length is 3000 letters. *Please note that mentioning a non-member will automatically grant can View access. 2. Create Editor: You can edit the color, font, background color, or add emojis and attachments on the comment. Supported formats for attachments are: png, jpg, jpeg, pjpeg, gif, bmp. You may attach up to 25 files per Comment. Shortcut keys available on Edit Mode: Bold: Ctrl (Cmd) + B Italic: Ctrl (Cmd) + I Underline: Ctrl (Cmd) + U @Mention: @ + name Emoji : [Window + . ] OR [Ctrl+Cmd+Space Bar] 3. View All Versions: By default, you will comments on all Versions. Uncheck to only view the comments created on current Version. Attach Images to your Comment (updated Feb 2024) Drag &amp Drop Images from your local drive. Preview Images before posting. Availability to post Images only (without a text). 2) Search Comment Search the comment you're looking for. Type in the keyword, and hit enter to view the results at the bottom. 3) Workroom &amp Assortment Comment Commenting is also available at the Workroom and Assortment level. Please see below for details on Permissions (create, edit, and delete) 4) Web Tech Pack Comment Commenting is also available on all Web Tech Pack tabs. Comments are created/saved separate on each Tab (Overview, BOM, Construction, Measurement, and Cost Estimation). Under each Comment, you can find the version information of the uploaded file. Please see below for details on Permissions (create, edit, and delete) 5) Permission Space Action Admin &amp Collaborator Editor Viewer All Create O O O Workroom WTP Content Edit Group, Company Admin: O Brand Admin, Collaborator: Limited* Limited* Delete Assortment Edit Admin: O Collaborator: Limited* Delete All Mention others O O X *Can only Edit/Delete comments created by oneself, cannot modify comments created by other users. **Permission varies on Space Level. To start using Comment features, user must have permission to the applicable Space/Content. For example, if a user holds Content Editor permission, they can create new Comment on that Content, but may not be able to create Workroom Content. 6) Notification When a Comment is created/edited/deleted, notification will be sent to all users with permission to the Workroom/Assortment/Content. To stop receiving notifications, end users can turn off notification settings on specific Space or Content by unchecking the 'bell' button. Notification of new Comments will be displayed on the Notifications tab. Email Notification may be sent based on the end user's notification settings on 'My Page'. <table style="border-collapse: collapse width: 86.2857%">

Title: China Account Sign Up
Content: Objective Follow the instructions below to create a China account in CLO-SET Sign Up Guide (China User) Troubleshooting Using CLO &amp Marvelous Designer *For questions related to your account (creating, merging, deleting) or subscriptions, please visit the CLO Virtual Fashion Help Center. Details 1) Sign Up Guide (China user) If you are an existing CLO-SET user, please follow the account merging guide HERE. If you do not have a CLO-SET account yet, please follow the steps below. 1. Please log in to start using CLO-SET 2) Troubleshooting Not receiving SMS verification? Please contact us via support@clo-set.com or submit a request Not receiving verification email? Title: Workroom View
Content: Objective Learn how to navigate CLO-SET Dashboard and utilize your Workroom Space Menus (Left Pane) Space (Room View) Comment, Share (Right Pane) Details 1) Menus (Left Pane) 1. Group Name: See which Group you're currently in. To switch the Group, click on the downward arrow () next to the Group's name. The Blue Crown indicates that you are the Group Admin. 2. Menu Tab Browse: View the space hierarchy and navigate to the desired Space Workspace: View all Spaces by level. (ex. Click on 'Companies' to view all Company Space you have access to) Console: View Admin Console for usage data, billing, and developer page. Favorites: View all Spaces and Contents you've marked as Favorite Search: Search Contents using everyday words or an image. 2) Space (Room View) 3. Space Info Upload: Upload a new Content in current Workroom Create: Create a sub-Space Notifications: Turn notifications on/off for current Space Favorite: Mark/unmark the Space as Favorite Navigation: Shows the hierarchy of the Space you are in 4. Line Sheet &amp Statistics 5. Space Name: Name of the Space you are in (Brand Workroom) 6. Search Bar: Search Contents within the Space 7. Filter: Filter the Contents you want to view 3)Comment, Share (Right Pane) Share to People Invite/Share: Invite or share with teammates Invite: for Company/Brand Share: for Workroom/Content Share with Link: Turning this option on will convert the Space to public status. Be ware of the security implications when sharing with link. Accessible People: View the list of teammates with access to this Space. This may include those with access to higher-level Spaces. For example, anyone with access to a Brand will be able to view all Workroom within the Brand. Workroom Comment Commenting is also available at the Workroom. Please follow the hyperlink to view detailed Permissions.

Title: Company Library
Content: Objective Company Library is a cloud repository that helps brands store, source, manage, and share essential digital contents. You can use Company Library to centralize and organize brand logo, virtual fabric/trim, block pattern, avatar/dummy, and more. Accessibility Favorite Search Turn On/Off Company Library Details 1) Accessibility Company Library can be accessed by both Company Admin and Collaborator as well as the Brand Admin and Brand Collaborator under that Company. But it could additionally be shared to other users as Company Library Editor or Viewer. You may think of Company Library as a separate workspace to store/share common assets, so the permission for Company Library is also separate from other workrooms in the Company. Download Upload Delete Company Admin / Collaborator Brand Admin / Collaborator o o o Company Library Editor o o x Company Library Viewer x x x 2) Favorite You can designate Company Library into Favorites by clicking the icon , and enter Favorite Company Library, Workroom or content page using the Shortcut menu on the left side of the page. 3) Search for Content Name &amp ID You can also search for Content Name or ID by using Search function on each Space page. Note: What is Content Type &amp ID? Click here 4) Turn On/Off Company Library Company Admin can turn on/off Company Library Function. Title: Move Workroom/Style
Content: Objective You can move Workroom or Style page to the other Space(Season, Workroom) that you belong to. Instruction Details 1. Instruction Put a mouse cursor on the desired Style and click the icon Click the icon and 'Move'. You can select the desired Space(Season, Workroom) that you would like to move to. the Workroom or Style page will be moved accordingly. *You can also move multiple Styles with Multi-Selection ( Note: Multi-Selection Manual)

Title: Favorite
Content: Objective Favorite Company Library, Workroom or Content page allows you to mark and group workrooms of your choice for convenient access. You can easily browse and download Favorite Workrooms &amp Contents in CLO3D. Add &amp View Favorite Utilizing Favorite in CLO3D Details 1) Add &amp View Favorite Start by adding a Workroom or Content as your Favorite from your CLO-SET page. You may add a Company Library Space to your Favorite list as well. On the left pane of your Dashboard, click on 'Favorites' to view the full list. 2)Utilizing Favorite in CLO3D Search/Download your Favorite Workroom &amp Contents directly from CLO3D software. Visit HERE to see how CLO-SET in CLO works, and how to connect your account. Once your account is setup, quickly access your Favorites list in CLO3D's Library.

Title: CLO-SET in CLO
Content: Objective You can link your CLO-SET account in CLO Software to easily access your CLO-SET contents in CLO software. 1. Add your CLO-SET account 2. Access CLO-SET contents in CLO 3. Delete/Change the linked account Details 1) Add your CLO-SET account in CLO 1. In CLO 3D's Library section, click on 'CLO-SET' cloud icon. 2. Click on 'Profile' icon to add your CLO-SET account 3. Click 'Add Account' and CLO-SET log in browser will pop up. 2) Access CLO-SET contents in CLO Upon log in, you will see your CLO-SET account on CLO's Library section. Single-click the content to download it. Double-click the downloaded content to load them in CLO. 3) Delete/Change the linked account From the CLO3D screen, click on the profile image icon to delete or change your CLO-SET account. You may only add 1 CLO-SET account at a time. You will still have access to all Groups to which the CLO-SET account has access to. For more information on how to UPLOAD your contents from CLO &gt CLO-SET, click HERE.

Title: [Enterprise Plan] Direct upload from CLO Software
Content: Objective For Enterprise plan users, You can directly upload a 3D project file including or excluding garment/avatar from CLO Software to CLO-SET and easily share it with other users. Set Preference in CLO3D Direct upload from CLO3D to CLO-SET Details 1) Set preference in CLO3D 1. Sign in to CLO 2. Main Menu Settings User Settings CLOSET 3. Enter and modify your exclusive CLO-SET URL. 2) Direct upload from CLO3D to CLO-SET Main Menu File Share via CLOSET Project/Garment/Avatar Main Menu Project/Garment/Avatar 1. You will be directed to the upload page in CLO-SET. * If you are not a registered user of CLO-SET, you are directed to the sign up page. 2. Select desired Workroom or Style that you'd like to upload or upgrade the 3D file. 3. Click 'Next' button and the file will start uploading.

Title: Content Type & ID
Content: Objective Any 3D/2D/other files uploaded on CLO-SET is designated as a Content. For each Content, you may identify the Content Type to be used throughout CLO-SET, including Tech Pack and Line Sheet. You may also search for relevant Content Type &amp ID by using General Search Function. Content Type Content ID Content Type in Web Tech Pack (BOM) Details 1) Content Type Every Content is classified as a single Content Type in CLO-SET. At the time of upload, you may select the Content Type. Or, for specific file formats, CLO-SET will automatically assign a Content Type. *Any zprj/zpac files uploaded will automatically be identified as a Style Content Type. 2) Content ID Content ID is a unique ID auto-assigned by CLO-SET upon file upload. Content created on or after April 9th, 2024 Content ID is made up of 6 digit number. Each Group will have Content IDs starting from 000001. Content created before April 9th, 2024 Content ID is made up of 3 letter Prefix (Content Type) + 6 digit number. Each Group will have Content IDs starting from 000001. Prefix List: 3) Content Type in Web Tech Pack (BOM) You may add Fabric/Graphic/Trim information on Web Tech Pack - BOM tab. Please note that the file format needs to match the Content Type to be added on BOM.

Title: Attachment
Content: Objective Upload Attachments as a reference for your Content Attach file from local PC Attach file from OneDrive Details 1) Attach file from local PC From the Content page, click on the Attachment icon on the right pane. To upload a file from your local PC, click on 'Upload a file' on the top. Please note that the attachment file size must be less than 500mb. 2) Attach file from OneDrive You may also attach a file from your shared OneDrive folder Click on 'OneDrive' button from the Attachment tab, and select the file you want to add.

Title: Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload)
Content: Permission(in CLO-SET Group): Admin, Collaborator, Editor, Viewer with Upload Objective You can directly upload a 3D project file including or excluding garment/avatar from CLO Software to CLO-SET. You may also easily run Render or generate Excel Tech Pack via CLO-SET. Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload) Render via CLO-SET Tech Pack via CLO-SET Details 1) Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload) 1. 'Share via CLO-SET' from CLO Software. Option 1 Option 2 File &gt Share via CLO-SET Main Menu 2. Once your file is ready to upload, click 'OK'. If you are not signed into CLO-SET yet, you will be directed to Sign In page. 3. Choose the Group/Location in which you want to upload the file, or select an existing file in CLO-SET for a version update. 1) Select the Group you want to upload the file to 2) You may choose whether or not you want to notify collaborators in your Group. You may also choose to apply Auto Numbering for CLO-SET to automatically name the content. 3) Upload a new content to an existing Workroom. Click '+MORE' to view the full list. User must have an upload permission to select Workroom. (permissions: Admin, Collaborator, Editor, or Viewer with Upload) Click '+MORE' to view the 'Browse' tab. Only the Spaces to which you have upload permission will be displayed. 4) Version update an existing content. Select an existing content from your CLO-SET space, and upload the file as a newer version (ex. version 2) instead of a separate content. 4. Final view in CLO-SET For Project/Garment/Avatar upload, you will see the 3D viewer in CLO-SET 2) Render via CLO-SET For Render via CLO-SET, once the file is uploaded, Render will start automatically. Learn more about CLO-SET Render HERE. *Rendering will be done per your Render Settings in CLO 3) Tech Pack via CLO-SET For Tech Pack via CLO-SET, once the file is uploaded, Excel Tech Pack will be downloaded automatically. Learn more about Excel Tech Packs HERE. For more information on how to link your CLO-SET account in CLO, click HERE.

Title: Minimum System Requirements for CLO-SET
